name: Inflict Pain, Mass
body:
Source Occult Adventures pg. 174
School enchantment [mind-affecting, pain]; Level antipaladin 4, arcanist 7, inquisitor 5, medium 4, mesmerist 5, occultist 5, psychic 6, sorcerer 7, spiritualist 5, witch 7, wizard 7
Casting
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S
Effect
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart.
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will partial, see text; Spell Resistance yes
Description
This spell functions like inflict pain except as noted above.
